boundary: The rational/complex Specht decomposition is exact. An integral Z[S8]-lattice splitting and a canonical identification with the project’s 35 lines and 90 center-quads are not asserted.

project_count_bridge.35: dimension of S^(5,1,1,1), matching the PG(3,2) line count
project_count_bridge.90: dimension of S^(4,2,1,1), matching the center-quad count
project_count_bridge.status: dimension-level exact bridge; no canonical objectwise bijection asserted

theorem: Over Q, H2 of the Johnson clique complex is the multiplicity-free S8-module S^(5,1,1,1) direct-sum S^(4,2,1,1), of dimensions 35 and 90. Its character is computed objectwise by the simplicial Lefschetz trace formula on all 22 conjugacy classes.
